packages.title: Hitamo paketi ikubereye
packages.subtitle: Paketi z’imyitozo zifite igihe cyiza kandi kode ziboneka ako kanya kuri SMS.
packages.description: Reba amahitamo y’ipaketi utangire imyitozo n’ibibazo by’ikizamini bya Rwanda.

hero.description: Urubuga rwuzuye rwo kwiga amategeko y’umuhanda mu Rwanda. Kora ibibazo bimeze nk’ibya’ikizamini, ukurikirane aho ugeze, kandi utsinde ufite icyizere.
hero.phoneQuestion: Umuvuduko ntarengwa mu gace gatuwe ni uwuhe?

steps.title: Hitamo paketi
steps.desc: Hitamo umubare w’ibizamini ushaka gukora. Paketi zitangirira kuri 500 RWF.

steps.title: Wishyura na MoMo
steps.desc: Wishyura ukoresheje MTN Mobile Money cyangwa Airtel Money uhite ubona kode kuri SMS.

steps.title: Tangira imyitozo
steps.desc: Shyiramo kode yawe utangire gukora ibizamini by’imyitozo bifite ibisobanuro ako kanya.

traffic.title: Menya ibyapa byo ku muhanda.
traffic.subtitle: Reba ibyiciro bine by’ibyapa byo mu Rwanda bikunze kugaragara mu kizamini cya provisoire.

warning.label: Iburira
warning.intro: Ibyapa bya mpandeshatu zitukura bikuburira ibyago biri imbere. Gabanya umuvuduko.
signs: Hari icyago imbere, itegure kugabanya umuvuduko.
Hari ikoni rikomeye imbere. Gabanya umuvuduko.
Hari akaga kadasobanuwe imbere — genda witonze.

priority.label: Icyambere
priority.intro: Ibi byapa bigaragaza ufite uburenganzira bwo kubanza mu masangano.
signs: Tanga inzira ku modoka ziri mu muhanda munini.

prohibition.label: Ibibujijwe
prohibition.intro: Ibyapa bizengurutse bitukura bigaragaza ibikorwa bitemewe.

mandatory.label: Ibigomba gukorwa
mandatory.intro: Ibyapa by’ubururu bizengurutse bigaragaza ibyo ugomba gukurikiza.
signs: Imodoka zigomba gukurikiza icyerekezo cya rond-point.

quiz.title: Gerageza ikibazo kimeze nk’icy’ikizamini.
quiz.subtitle: Ibibazo 5. Nta konti isabwa.
quiz.question: IKIBAZO
quiz.perfect: Amanota yose! Witeguye gukora ikizamini nyacyo.
quiz.onTrack: Uri mu nzira nziza. Komeza kwitoza kugira ngo usobanukirwe amategeko akomeye.
quiz.keepGoing: Ntugire ikibazo — ni cyo Kora igufasha. Komeza imyitozo.

exams.examSubtitle: Kurikirana buri kizamini cyibazwa ibibazo 20, ugomba gutsinda 12/20. Wahisemo {count}

pricing.title: Witeguye gutsinda?
pricing.subtitle: Gura kode z’ikizamini utangire urugendo. Kode zose zimara iminsi 30 uhereye igihe uzikoresheje bwa mbere.

terms.title: Amategeko ya Serivisi
terms.paragraph1: Ukoresheje cyangwa wifashishije Koraapp.net wemera amategeko. Niba utabyemera, ntukoreshe uru rubuga.
terms.paragraph2: Kode z’ibizamini zose zigurwa hakoreshejwe MTN MoMo cyangwa Airtel Money ziba zuzuye iminsi 30 kuva uko zakoreshejwe bwa mbere. Kode ni uwaziguze gusa ntizishobora guhanwa.
terms.paragraph3: Kode zidakoreshwa zishobora gusubizwa amafaranga mu minsi 7. Iyo kode imaze gukoreshwa, ntisubizwa keretse biteganywa n’amategeko.

privacy.title: Politiki y’Ibanga
privacy.paragraph1: Dukoresha nimero yawe ya telefone kugirango twohereze kode za SMS, inyandiko z’amafaranga ya MoMo, n’ibipimo by’imyitozo (ibibazo wisubije, igihe, amanota).
privacy.paragraph2: Nimero yawe ikoreshwa gusa mu kohereza kode n’amatangazo y’ingenzi. Amakuru y’imyitozo akoreshwa mu byo gukurikirana aho ugeze.
privacy.paragraph3: Ushobora gusaba kubona, gukosora cyangwa gusiba amakuru yawe iyo ari yo yose ukoresheje email privacy@koraapp.net.

footer.description: Kora ni urubuga ruyoboye mu kwigisha amategeko y’umuhanda mu Rwanda, rufasha abanyeshuri ibihumbi kubona perimi buri mwaka.
footer.rights: Kora Driving Platform. Uburenganzira bwose burabitswe.
